title: Biskuit di Canang
subject: a young woman in Denpasar whose morning round of placing canang offerings in front of the family shop is followed every day by a skinny brown stray dog who eats the biscuit off each offering, until she starts quietly putting one extra biscuit just for him and names him Kopi
caption: Balinese pop with rindik, modern pop Bali sung in Indonesian. Rindik bamboo xylophone playing interlocking ostinato patterns, suling Bali breathy flute melody, light kendang Bali rhythm, strummed acoustic guitar, soft electric bass. Airy natural production with bamboo resonance up front and light reverb. Bright friendly female mid-register vocal, clearly sung melody. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 112 BPM, G major. Mood of a cheerful morning errand with a stray dog. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no heavy rock guitar, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - rindik ostinato, suling]
[Verse 1]
Jam enam pagi di depan toko
Aku taruh canang satu per satu
Anjing cokelat kurus mengekor
Ekornya goyang di belakangku
[Pre-Chorus]
Satu canang, satu biskuit
Dia ambil, dia lari sedikit
[Chorus]
Hei, Kopi, jangan curi lagi
Itu bukan buat kamu
Besok pagi aku bawa satu
Biskuit khusus untukmu
[Verse 2]
Ibu di dalam pura-pura marah
Tapi dia simpan tulang dari dapur
Kopi duduk di anak tangga
Menunggu aku, nggak pernah kabur
[Chorus]
Hei, Kopi, ini bagianmu
Yang di canang biar saja
Sekarang kamu tunggu aku
Sebelum matahari di atas pura
[Outro - rindik alone, fading]
Hei, Kopi
Sampai besok pagi
